name: FHIR Router Mediator
description: OpenHIM mediator that routes a FHIR transaction Bundle by resource type: Patient -> OpenCR (identity), clinical -> SHR. Receives bundles on the /consolidated/fhir channel from the data pipeline and de-dupes entries. Source vendored in-repo at projects/fhir-router-mediator; FHIR_ROUTER_IMAGE defaults to the locally-built fhir-router-mediator:local (./build-custom-images.sh).
